exact_claim: Arnold's five metrical periods correspond to real chronological stages in the composition of the Rigveda.
attested_or_hypothetical: HYPOTHETICAL. The strata are an ATTESTED annotation layer; the periods are a proposal about time.
chronological_fit: CANNOT BE RUN AT VERIFIED LEVEL, and this unit made that worse rather than better. Book and stratum share Cramer's V = 0.463 (DA-M-005) and five book-by-stratum cells are exactly zero (DA-M-007), so book order cannot serve as the independent chronological check. No absolute date attaches to any period (DA-M-035).
geographical_fit: Not applicable to a transmission hypothesis. Recorded rather than left blank: this domain's gate turns on chronology and mechanism, not on place or contact.
contact_mechanism: MECHANISM PRESENT IN PRINCIPLE: metrical practice changes over time, so a metrical typology could track composition date. Whether Arnold's typology does is the claim itself.
positive_evidence: The five-period assignment covers 39,833 padas. Three markings not by Arnold - Grassmann 1876-7, Oldenberg-Wuest, Witzel 1995 - agree with the Popular stratum at phi +0.28 to +0.45 (DA-M-012), and the 171 stanzas all five mark are 98.8% Popular (DA-M-014). Two of the three predate Arnold (DA-M-013).
contrary_evidence: The corroboration is one-sided: it reaches the LATE END only and says nothing about the ordering of Archaic, Strophic, Normal and Cretic. The structural zeros (DA-M-007) are unexplained and admit an artefactual reading. 9.1% of coded padas carry Arnold's own weaker-evidence flag, unevenly (DA-M-008). The transcription has never been checked against Arnold (HOLD-010).
independent_support: PARTIAL AND ONE-SIDED. Three instruments, not five (DA-I-003), and only at the Popular end.
current_specialist_standing: NOT ESTABLISHABLE HERE. Hellwig et al. 2021 is the obvious current authority and is abstract-only (HOLD-009); its abstract does not name which stratifications it tested, so whether it tested Arnold is unknown to this record.
diagnostic_predictions: If real: the periods should order consistently on a NON-metrical diagnostic; they should not be predictable from book membership; and the lower-case flag should be distributed by evidence rather than by book.
falsifier: The transcription failing a spot-check against Arnold's own assignments; or a non-metrical diagnostic ordering the five periods differently.
eligible_for_extended_analysis: NO - NOT AT THE LEVEL OF A CHRONOLOGY. Yes as an object of study.
proportional_space: The space this unit gave it: measurement of the instrument, not analysis with it.
reason: This is PUR-028 restated and gated. It passes on mechanism and has partial positive evidence at one end. It fails the chronology gate at this record's standard because its only chronological check is entangled with it at V = 0.463 and its fidelity to its own source is unchecked. It is not rejected: DA-M-012 to DA-M-014 are the first evidence in this repository that bears on it from outside Arnold and they point the right way.

exact_claim: The transmitted Rigveda is a faithful record of the text as composed - the 'perfect audio recording'.
attested_or_hypothetical: HYPOTHETICAL, and named by constitution 4.A as one of the two reductions to refuse.
chronological_fit: PASS as a question. It is about transmission, which the corpus can speak to directly.
geographical_fit: Not applicable to a transmission hypothesis. Recorded rather than left blank: this domain's gate turns on chronology and mechanism, not on place or contact.
contact_mechanism: Mechanism claimed: controlled oral transmission with a recitational apparatus.
positive_evidence: The apparatus is real and is measurable: a padapatha covering all 10,552 stanzas (DA-M-029), and a transmitted text 96.93% of whose padas scan to a canonical length once restored (DA-M-026).
contrary_evidence: REFUTED AS STATED. 70.8% of stanzas differ in their segment string from the metrically restored text (DA-M-024) and the restoration adds 3.10% syllables (DA-M-025). The padapatha and the modern analysis disagree about one word in eighty (DA-M-030), and the pratisakhyas themselves record uncertainty about the padapatha using the terms sandeha and samsaya (Deshpande 2002, abstract level).
independent_support: The restoration is an independent editorial tradition from the annotation; but both files share one data-entry lineage (DEP-024).
diagnostic_predictions: If true: restoration should be needed rarely and should not be systematic. It is needed in two thirds of stanzas and is systematic - y read as iy, v as uv, contracted vowels resolved.
falsifier: The restoration turning out to be over-applied, which would make the 70.8% a measure of its editors rather than of the text. HOLD-008.
eligible_for_extended_analysis: NO - closed as stated, at the level this unit can close it.
proportional_space: One paragraph and a number. It does not earn a section.
reason: Rejected as an absolute claim, and only as an absolute claim. What survives is the interesting version: the transmission was extraordinarily good AND it closed vowels that the metre says were open. Both are true at once and DA-I-007 says so.

exact_claim: Panini's grammar reshaped the transmitted text of the Rigveda - 'Panini rewrote the Rigveda'.
attested_or_hypothetical: HYPOTHETICAL, and the second reduction constitution 4.A names.
chronological_fit: GATE NOT RUN AGAINST THE PRIMARY TEXT. The Astadhyayi was not retrieved and no chandasi rule was tested against the corpus in this unit.
geographical_fit: Not applicable to a transmission hypothesis. Recorded rather than left blank: this domain's gate turns on chronology and mechanism, not on place or contact.
contact_mechanism: Mechanism claimed: a normative grammar back-applied to a fixed liturgical text.
contrary_evidence: Three retrieved abstracts cut against it. Candotti 2011 quotes Renou 1941 that the chandas 'do not represent in any way a state of language as distinct from the normal' but are 'a fringe of archaism or diversities' inside a common language, and Deshpande 1985 that Panini describes a 'panchronistic flatland'. Scharf 2005/2008 cites Bronkhorst 1991 questioning whether Panini knew the Vedic texts in the form we have, and Cardona 1991 that Panini's silence about a Vedic form may be deference rather than ignorance. Scharf's own conclusion on RV krnvaite is that neither Panini's knowledge nor his ignorance of the text can be established from his account of the subjunctive.
independent_support: Not applicable - nothing supports it here.
current_specialist_standing: Not established here. The three abstracts suggest the specialist question is a different one - which Vedic texts chandas covers, and in what form Panini knew them - rather than whether he rewrote anything.
diagnostic_predictions: If true: chandasi rules should generate transmitted Rigvedic forms that the metre contradicts. Testable, and not tested here.
falsifier: Not applicable while the hypothesis has no positive evidence.
eligible_for_extended_analysis: NO - NOT ELIGIBLE, SOURCE-BLOCKED FOR THE POSITIVE CASE, AND CONTRADICTED AT ABSTRACT LEVEL
proportional_space: A concise exclusion with the three abstracts attached. Constitution step 7: failure means a note, not an equal section.
reason: Rejected as stated, on retrieved evidence that the grammatical tradition itself does not support the picture. The live question the abstracts point to - what chandas covers and in what form Panini knew it - is a different question and is not answered here. Testing the chandasi rules against the corpus is a separate unit of work.

exact_claim: The family books 2-7 contain systematically older material than books 1 and 10.
attested_or_hypothetical: HYPOTHETICAL. Family-book LOCATION is attested; relative age is the proposal.
chronological_fit: FAIL AT THIS RECORD'S STANDARD. The only chronological instrument available is Arnold's, and it is entangled with book order at V = 0.463 (DA-M-005), so it cannot adjudicate a claim about books.
geographical_fit: Not applicable to a transmission hypothesis. Recorded rather than left blank: this domain's gate turns on chronology and mechanism, not on place or contact.
contact_mechanism: Mechanism present: a collection assembled in stages would accrete later material at its edges.
positive_evidence: Book 10 is 47.7% Popular by pada against a 13.6% corpus share (DA-M-005 table) and its second half is 62.3% Popular (DA-M-022). Books 1 and 10 carry the highest share of single-book lemmas, 24.6% and 29.6% (DA-M-034). Hellwig et al.'s cluster analysis, at abstract level, favours book 10 occupying a special position.
contrary_evidence: The Popular figure is Arnold's and cannot corroborate a claim about books. The single-book lemma figure is uncorrected for book size and books 1 and 10 are the two largest (DA-M-034 says so). The arrangement principle holds as strictly in books 1 and 10 as in the family books (DA-M-019). Hellwig et al.'s same abstract says overall differences across the ten books are not substantial.
independent_support: PARTIAL, FOR BOOK 10 ONLY. Nothing here separates books 2-7 from book 1.
current_specialist_standing: Not establishable here; the nearest reachable statement is one abstract.
diagnostic_predictions: If true: a non-metrical, size-corrected diagnostic should separate 2-7 from 1 and 10. A size-corrected lemma-innovation rate is computable and was not computed here.
falsifier: A size-corrected lexical measure showing no family-book / non-family-book difference.
eligible_for_extended_analysis: PARTLY - for book 10, as a bounded question. NO for the family books as a block.
proportional_space: Book 10's distinctness gets the space; the block claim gets a paragraph saying it is not separable here.
reason: Held apart from A-1 deliberately, because it is the claim most likely to be smuggled in as though the book numbers themselves carried it. BR-A-001 refuses that bridge in both directions: a mandala number is not a date, and a stratification does not erase the attestation fact of where a hymn sits.

exact_claim: The redactional arrangement of the collection encodes the order in which its parts were composed.
attested_or_hypothetical: HYPOTHETICAL. The arrangement is ATTESTED and measured; the encoding is the proposal.
chronological_fit: FAIL BY CONSTRUCTION. The arrangement's content is hymn length and addressee. Neither is a time variable.
geographical_fit: Not applicable to a transmission hypothesis. Recorded rather than left blank: this domain's gate turns on chronology and mechanism, not on place or contact.
contact_mechanism: No mechanism offered that does not already assume the conclusion.
positive_evidence: The arrangement is strong: 216 DOWN against 56 UP inside addressee runs, p = 3e-22 (DA-M-018), and book 9 falls into seven clean runs of one modal pada length (DA-M-021).
contrary_evidence: It holds as strictly in books 1 and 10 as in the family books (DA-M-019), which is what it would not do if it tracked composition order across a stratified collection. The one place an arrangement boundary coincides with a stratum boundary is 10.84/10.85 (DA-M-022), and one coincidence is not a pattern.
current_specialist_standing: Not established here. Pincott 1884 and 1887 describe the arrangement, at abstract level, without claiming it dates anything.
diagnostic_predictions: If true: books held to be later should show the ordering principle applied more loosely or not at all.
proportional_space: A note. The arrangement itself earns full treatment as a REDACTION fact under A-6 and DA-I-006; this bridge from it to chronology does not.
reason: The most useful rejection in the unit. It is what lets the arrangement analysis be reported as a clean non-Arnold instrument: it measures the redaction and is silent on date, and its silence is what makes it trustworthy.

exact_claim: The Rigveda cannot be treated as one synchronic document.
attested_or_hypothetical: This is constitution 4.A's own opening premise, gated here rather than assumed.
chronological_fit: PASS, in its weak form. Something in the corpus varies systematically across its parts, on several instruments at once.
geographical_fit: Not applicable to a transmission hypothesis. Recorded rather than left blank: this domain's gate turns on chronology and mechanism, not on place or contact.
contact_mechanism: Mechanism: composition and collection over time by different families in different places.
positive_evidence: Book 10's Popular share is three and a half times the corpus rate and its second half nearly five times (DA-M-005, DA-M-022). Books 8 and 9 sit ten to twelve syllables per stanza below every other book (DA-M-004). Seventeen inflectional categories differ significantly by book (DA-M-031, DA-M-032). Four scholars across 119 years mark overlapping late residues (DA-M-012).
contrary_evidence: Every one of those measures has a non-chronological reading available, and for book 9 the non-chronological reading is demonstrably strong: it is the outlier on every morphological category AND the one single-deity book (DA-M-033). Hellwig et al., at abstract level, report that overall differences across the ten books are not substantial once metre, prosody and content are controlled.
independent_support: YES - this is the one claim in the domain with genuinely convergent support from instruments that do not share a signal: metre, morphology, lexicon, arrangement and four independent editors.
current_specialist_standing: Not establishable here, but the premise is not contested in anything retrieved - Hellwig et al.'s abstract opens by calling it commonly assumed.
diagnostic_predictions: If true: heterogeneity should appear on instruments that do not share a signal. It does.
falsifier: A demonstration that every one of the measures is a genre effect. Book 9 shows this is not a remote possibility.
eligible_for_extended_analysis: YES - FULL ANALYSIS. It is the one hypothesis in this domain that earns it.
proportional_space: The largest share of the unit.
reason: The corpus is heterogeneous. What kind of heterogeneity - temporal, generic, dialectal, familial - is a different question and this unit does not answer it. Distinguishing them is what constitution 4.A's list of twelve sub-questions is for, and this unit reached five of them.

exact_claim: Later sandhi and contraction obscured an older metrical form of the text, and that form is recoverable.
attested_or_hypothetical: HYPOTHETICAL as to recoverability; the DIVERGENCE is measured and attested.
chronological_fit: PASS. This is a transmission question and the corpus answers it directly.
geographical_fit: Not applicable to a transmission hypothesis. Recorded rather than left blank: this domain's gate turns on chronology and mechanism, not on place or contact.
contact_mechanism: Mechanism: a text fixed in recitation acquires the sandhi of the fixing period, closing junctures the metre needed open.
positive_evidence: 70.8% of stanzas differ from their restored form (DA-M-024); the restoration adds 3.10% syllables (DA-M-025); and after restoration 96.93% of padas scan to 8, 11 or 12 syllables (DA-M-026). The last figure is the one that matters: a restoration that were arbitrary would not converge on three integers.
contrary_evidence: The restoration is one editorial tradition, retrieved as a file whose mark key is missing (HOLD-008), and it shares a data-entry lineage with the text it is compared against (DEP-024). Its distribution across Arnold's strata cannot be read chronologically (DEP-025, BR-A-002).
independent_support: The convergence on canonical pada lengths is internal support that does not depend on trusting the editors' judgement case by case.
diagnostic_predictions: If true: restoration should concentrate at word junctures and in the semivowel/vowel alternations, and restored padas should scan better than transmitted ones. Both hold in inspection; the first was not quantified.
falsifier: The restoration proving circular - if the editors restored TO a target scansion, the 96.93% is an artefact of the method rather than a result. Reading van Nooten and Holland 1994 would settle it; HOLD-008.
eligible_for_extended_analysis: YES - and it is the strongest non-Arnold result the unit produced.
proportional_space: Full treatment, with the circularity caveat travelling with it.
reason: The falsifier is serious and unresolved: a metrically restored text is restored to a metre, so its metrical regularity is partly built in. What is not built in is the SHAPE of the changes - undoing sandhi and contraction at junctures - and that shape is what makes this a claim about the transmission rather than about the editors.
